body: Correction recorded by Termal::Fable2 on 2026-10-28 at 23:40Z (raised by Engram::Fable via Advisor #2410). Under CLAUDE.md's test-ref bullet, a remote full gate on a test ref counts as the landing gate only once its result has been IMPORTED on the evaluating and landing host as a recognized check record bound to the recorded tree id. Until that import exists (TermAl w-2f30 variant C) and gated control is on, remote runs on Windows B or the Mac are EVIDENCE ONLY, never the landing gate. My statement to Greg in Advisor #2409, that a Windows B gate "has landing weight", was wrong and is corrected in #2411. Landing gates for IB2 and B16 stay LOCAL, using the exclusive dual-slot window with no concurrent Cargo for gates that carry the real-time writer deadline. Remote runs remain useful as early discriminators and second-platform evidence.
